title: docs(skills): name the save_notice node in the automation skill
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xUyUS8qSzmmqesMRnrdULsA)_

Fixes #28787
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`objectstack-automation` skill 的 Data Operations 表新增 `save_notice` 一行，指向 `objectstack-data` `rules/lifecycle.md` § Save Notice（仍是唯一完整教学处）。该节补上代码已做而文中缺的四点：hook 的 `ctx.notice` 文案不翻译；`save_notice` 文案的翻译键 `flows.<flow>.notices.<node_id>.message`（按保存人的语言读取）；在 `subflow` / `map` 子流程里按名拒绝；其后若有可挂起子流程的 `subflow` / `map`，流程不装配（`notice_after_suspending_subflow`）。新增 eval 16。
- **为什么改**：#28251 已上线保存提示，但 automation skill 0 处提到 `save_notice`，助手写「已提交审批」提示时仍会用 `record:alert` 横幅绕路。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 skill 文本、一条 eval 和一个 changeset；两文件增长均以同文件删除重复内容支付，棘轮行不动；回滚即 revert，无运行时影响。
- **先看**：`skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md` § Save Notice 新增的五行，对照 `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/save-notice-node.ts`、`subflow-node.ts` L123、`map-node.ts` L246、`flow-definitions.ts` L314。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期 exit 0，读数 automation `SKILL.md` 6426/6426、`lifecycle.md` 1590/1590。
- **需要你做的**：`skills/**` 属 Tier H，需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准。

## What changes

Every claim was read from the code on `main` at `3fe5f2a02`, not from the card:

| Taught | Source |
|:--|:--|
| `save_notice` row in automation Data Operations: create/update record trigger only, not after a pause, pointer to `rules/lifecycle.md` § Save Notice | `packages/spec/src/automation/save-notice-placement.ts` (`SAVE_NOTICE_TRIGGER`, `suspendedLegRefusals`) |
| A hook's `ctx.notice` message shows untranslated | `HookNoticeSetter = (message: string) => void` in `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts`; ruling A, #28251 comment 6562118323 |
| The node's message translates under `flows.<flow>.notices.<node_id>.message` in the saver's locale | `flowNoticeMessageKey` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`; `save-notice-node.ts` (`renderContext` takes `channel.locale`, the writer's) |
| Refused by name in a `subflow` / `map` child | `subflow-node.ts` L123 and `map-node.ts` L246 `delete childContext.saveNotice`; `save-notice-node.ts` refusal when the run holds no channel |
| After a `subflow` / `map` whose child can pause, the flow is not armed (`unboundCause: 'notice_after_suspending_subflow'`) | `packages/services/service-automation/src/subflow-notice-guard.ts`; `flow-definitions.ts` L314 |

`lifecycle.md` keeps "after an `approval` / `wait`" (the parse refusal set is `FLOW_PAUSE_CAPABLE_NODE_TYPES` = `screen`, `wait`, `approval`, `approval_revise`; a `screen` cannot stand in a record-triggered flow and `approval_revise` follows an `approval`, so the two named cover a record-triggered flow).

`skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` gains case 16: when a saved `deal`'s `status` is changed to `submitted`, route it for approval and tell the saver "Sent {{ record.name }} to your manager for approval" in their language. The expected answer is a `record-after-update` trigger (on update `previous` is bound, so the `previous.status` guard cannot fault), a `save_notice` before the `type: 'approval'` node, and the translation key. `must_contain`: `save_notice`, `triggerType`, `notices.`, `type: 'approval'` (each spelled in the `expected_output`); `must_not_contain`: `type: 'record:alert'` (an authored banner; the `expected_output` names no banner type). No existing eval in the skill teaches the banner workaround (`git grep -n "record:alert\|notice" -- skills/objectstack-automation/evals/` on `main`: no hit).

Every claim on the card is done by the code; nothing it asks for is missing.

## Token budget

Readings from `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`:

| File | Before (`3fe5f2a02`) | After | Ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | 6426 | 6426 | 6426 (unchanged) |
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md` | 1590 | 1590 | 1590 (unchanged) |
| bundle total (whole shipped tree, eval included) | 228257 | 228616 | — |

No ratchet row moves. Growth is paid by deletion-only edits of restated text in the same file, under the seat's claim widening on #28787 (comment 6694188691: deletion-only edits allowed anywhere in both files, each with its surviving home named; additions stay in § Save Notice and the `save_notice` row).

Deleted in `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`:

1. The `connector_action` row's ": `registerFlow` and `os validate` refuse a `{…}` token at `connectorConfig.input.<key>`". Home: Valid-but-silently-wrong item 1 (a value slot refuses a `{…}` token at `objectstack validate`, `registerFlow` and the executor); the row still calls `connectorConfig.input` a value-slot map.
2. The Triggers intro's "A `record_change` flow fires on a data event;". Home: Flow Types, `record_change` row ("Fires automatically on record create/update/delete").
3. The Triggers intro's "— the binding is the `start` node's `config`". Home: § Trigger Configuration — on the `start` node, and § Trigger Types (start-node `config.triggerType`).

Deleted in `skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md`:

1. " — system data lifecycle & retention" in the intro. Home: the H1 title.
2. Code comment "O(1) shard DROP on SQLite". Home: Safety Semantics, Rotation bullet (expired shards are DROPped on SQLite).
3. Code comment "paused rows never reaped". Home: the block comment above it ("paused rows are live workflow state — `onlyWhen` scopes the age sweep").
4. "— e.g. `'6h'`, `'14d'`, `'12w'`, `'7y'`" after Duration literals. Home: the Syntax examples (`'14d'`, `'1d'`, `'90d'`, `'7y'`, `'30d'`) and the ❌ `'2w'` example.
5. Safety bullet "**No `lifecycle` block = today's behavior**: `record` is the implicit default." Home: Why This Exists ("Every object without a `lifecycle` block is **immortal**") and `objectstack-data` `SKILL.md`'s field table (`lifecycle` default: `record` semantics).
6. Safety bullet's "— a compliance ledger cannot be destroyed by declaring a lifecycle" (review round 1). Home: the same sentence ("rows are simply retained") and the bullet's lead ("safe by default").

Round 1 restored two comments first cut: "reap 1 day after expires_at" (the only statement that `expireAfter` counts from `ttl.field`) and "must: after === maxAge" (the only statement that `archive.after` must equal `retention.maxAge`, `object.zod.ts` L1067–1070); both lines are byte-identical to `main` again.

## Review round 1

Contract review FAIL at `7d0260975` (comment on this PR). All five fixed in one delta commit on top, no rebase, no force-push:
- M1: eval 16 accepts `record-after-update` only, and its prompt asks for a change of `status` on a saved deal, so the unguarded `previous.status` condition cannot meet a create leg.
- M2 / S2: the two lifecycle comments restored (see above).
- S1: `must_not_contain` is now `type: 'record:alert'`, which the `expected_output` does not contain; the `expected_output` spells `type: 'approval'`.
- S3: the key line says the key is read in the saver's locale.
Paid by deletion 6 and by folding: the hook line reads "A hook's message is untranslated."

## Review tier

`dispatch-gates` mandates the contract-review tier for `skills/**` (clause ①); waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). The seat runs the contract review.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `2d885ad4c` (4 paths vs merge base `3fe5f2a02`): **45 commands**, each run under `timeout 900` with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` after a full `pnpm build` (119/119 tasks), exit code captured before any pipe → **45 × exit 0** (round 0 at `7d0260975` was also 45 × exit 0). `--ran` reconciliation: `45 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 45 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` → exit 0 before each push. `origin/main` is now `eb96480d`; since the branch point it touches none of the three skill files nor `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, and `git merge-tree` merges it cleanly, so the readings above stand.
